instruction: Provide me a list of unused Security Groups by all regions. Tell me how many there are in total and what kind of security groups they mostly are.
expected_answer: You have {{4b68864e-UnusedSecurityGroupCount}} unused security groups. Most are default security groups automatically created for each VPC. In us-east-1, one of the unused security groups is {{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1-UnusedSecurityGroupId}}.
